_comment: Tame role trees (cooks/build-taming.md 2.2, survival-crafting 2.19; FULL-GAME 6.5 'one 20-point tree per role'). A tame uses its role's tree (creatures.json role, first word: 'fighter, scout' is fighter, 'farm animal' is farm). Nodes 0-3 are a line (each needs the one before), 4 and 5 are capstones: one of the two, after all four. cost: skill points (1 per bond level, 20 in all: 2 + 3 + 3 + 4 + 8). What each does lives in code by id (WRTaming.cpp, WRCombatLibrary, WRFarm); numbers in tuning.json tame.tree.

nodes.name: Pack tactics
nodes.text: +10% damage for each ally on the same target (up to 3)

nodes.name: Guardian
nodes.text: Within 4 m of you it takes 30% of the blows meant for you

nodes.name: Stalwart
nodes.text: Takes 40% less stance damage and is never knocked about

nodes.name: Charge
nodes.text: Sprinting into an enemy: it lowers its head, then hits for 40 and knocks it back

nodes.name: Steady seat
nodes.text: You stay in the saddle through blows under 80 stance

nodes.name: Steady
nodes.text: A full load doesn't slow it

nodes.name: Forager
nodes.text: What doesn't fit in your bag goes into its packs (8 m)

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.text: +200 health; you and your clan within 6 m take 10% less damage

nodes.name: Bright
nodes.text: Its light reaches 50% further; digging tames find 25% more ore

nodes.name: Lucky find
nodes.text: Now and then a gem in what it digs (15%)

nodes.name: Seeker
nodes.text: What it finds is called out to your clan with where

nodes.name: Lodestar
nodes.text: You and your clan within 10 m gather 15% more

nodes.name: Prize stock
nodes.text: 5% of its products are prize ones

nodes.name: Prolific
nodes.text: A quarter of its births are twins
